name: Bismuth-doped lead tin selenide
equilibrium_context: Topological crystalline insulator with gapless surface states

driven_states.emergent_property: Photoinduced evolution from topological to trivial: the topological surface state opens a gap of up to 0.1 eV.
driven_states.caveat: Included because of the topology, not because of the transport - only the band structure is measured, there is no transport signature. The mechanism is not electronic Floquet but a uniaxial distortion caused by the pulse; the assignment is made via the known phase diagram as a function of the lattice distortion, hence indirectly. Several pump parameters could not be substantiated and are left empty.
driven_states.measured_quantity: time- and angle-resolved photoemission, gap size of the surface state

gaps: Photon energy, fluence and temperature window could not be substantiated.
